cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've washed my cup after yours. There, a fresh start. Stay a bit longer; I don't want you leaving while we're still angry.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I rinsed mine because the tea was cold. I stayed to clean up, and that's done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, cold tea first. Sit with me for the part we haven't cleaned up yet.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got ten minutes before the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Give me nine, then. Leave the cups where they are and tell me what you're still angry about.
